metadata.title: Big Tech ETF rises as Tesla, Apple and Nvidia post sharp gains - MarketWatch

content.text:
14 hours ago
Big Tech ETF rises as Tesla, Apple and Nvidia post sharp gains
A popular exchange-traded that holds seven closely watched Big Tech stocks known as the Magnificent Seven was rising Monday, as most of its holdings advanced in late-morning trading.
The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF — whose holdings include Nvidia, Apple, Google parent Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon.com, Facebook parent Meta Platforms, and Tesla — was gaining 0.7%. Tesla had the biggest gains in the fund’s portfolio, up 3.2%. Apple and Nvidia shares also posted sharp gains, while Amazon's stock advanced more modestly, according to FactSet data, at last check.
Three of the seven Big Tech stocks held by the ETF were in the red late morning Monday, including Alphabet, Microsoft and Meta.
